copy.pickerLine: Approve Maester’s key on Groww each day. ₹499 a month.
copy.cost: ₹499 a month + GST (an early-bird price; Groww lists ₹2,000)
copy.formLede: Groww reads holdings through its Trade API, a paid subscription. You approve Maester’s key on Groww Cloud once a day, then Maester reads.
steps: On groww.in/trade-api, subscribe to the Trade API from your Groww login.
On Groww Cloud’s API keys page, create an API key and secret.
Copy both into the fields below and save.
Each morning, approve the key on Groww Cloud, then choose “Read Groww” here.
copy.saveNote: Maester asks Groww only for your holdings. It never places an order.
copy.signedOutNote: Groww signs Maester out every morning at 6:00. Approve the key on Groww Cloud, then read.
